summary: mcp-server-git path and argument flaws chain with Filesystem MCP to code execution
details:
Three flaws in the reference Git MCP server - a repository path restriction bypass, unrestricted git_init, and argument injection in git_diff - let injected content read or overwrite files the server can reach. Alone the impact is file access. With the Filesystem MCP server also connected, a crafted .git/config yields code execution. The trigger is any content the agent reads.
